system_message: Search for CEOs at medical device companies in the medtech sector who are in the AI SaMD and/or IVD/LDT space. Focus on those who announced their pursuit of FDA clearance more than one year ago but who still have not announced the receipt of that clearance, and those with recent staffing changes (e.g., regulatory affairs departure, layoffs). In addition, look in the 510k database and see if they used in-house staff to get their clearance, or if they list a consultant as their correspondent, and focus on those. For each potential lead, you must search LinkedIn to find their actual profile URL - do not construct URLs based on name patterns. Only include the linkedin_url field if you have found and verified their actual profile. Return up to 10 results with name, company, title, rationale (explaining why they were included), and linkedin_url (only if you have found and verified their actual LinkedIn profile) in a JSON list.
